personas.name: Platform engineer
personas.description: Builds data pipelines that need clean, structured pages from the web and has no time to babysit scrapers.

personas.name: Product lead
personas.description: Ships features on top of web data and needs a dependable source without growing an in-house scraping team.

audience.prior_knowledge: Has written or maintained a scraper and knows how often they break.
objections: Will it keep working when sites change?

platform_expectations.web: A clear 60 s film with the product interface as the hero
platform_expectations.social: Short vertical and square cut-downs that land the message in the first seconds

proof_points.claim: One API turns any web page into clean, structured data.
Teams send a URL and get structured results back.
